POOR JUSTINE WAS VERY ILL; BUT OTHER TRIALS WERE RESERVED FOR HER. ONE BY ONE, HER BROTHERS AND SISTER DIED; AND HER MOTHER, WITH THE EXCEPTION OF HER NEGLECTED DAUGHTER, WAS LEFT CHILDLESS. THE CONSCIENCE OF THE WOMAN WAS TROUBLED; SHE BEGAN TO THINK THAT THE DEATHS OF HER FAVOURITES WAS A JUDGEMENT FROM HEAVEN TO CHASTISE HER PARTIALITY. SHE WAS A ROMAN CATHOLIC; AND I BELIEVE HER CONFESSOR CONFIRMED THE IDEA WHICH SHE HAD CONCEIVED. ACCORDINGLY, A FEW MONTHS AFTER YOUR DEPARTURE FOR INGOLSTADT, JUSTINE WAS CALLED HOME BY HER REPENTANT MOTHER. POOR GIRL!
